title: People’s Mañanera November 10
author: Pedro Gellert
content:
_Every day, President Claudia Sheinbaum gives a morning presidential press
conference and Mexico Solidarity Media posts English language summaries,
translated by Mexico Solidarity 's Pedro Gellert. Previous press conference
summaries are available [here](https://mexicosolidarity.com/mananera/)._

**Mexico Reduces Intentional Homicides by 50%  
** President Claudia Sheinbaum highlighted the 50% reduction in homicides in a
country of 130 million inhabitants. Recalling that Vicente Fox warned Felipe
Calderón about the risks of declaring a war on crime, she noted that, in
practice, his government acted based on such a logic.

**Michoacán Posts 42% Fewer Intentional Homicides Under the Peace and Justice
Plan  
** It was reported that the daily average number of intentional homicides fell
from 3.48 to 2.03 between October 2025 and October 2026, posting a downward
trend since the plan was implemented.

**Nearly 200 Million Pesos (US$10.75 million) Recovered from García Luna Will
be Earmarked for Schools in the Mountains of Guerrero  
** The President reported that the funds from the imprisoned drug trafficker
and former Minister of Security will be allocated to “The School Is Ours”
program with priority given to the schools that need them the most. Parents
will decide what improvements to make, and information will be provided on how
the budget will be used.

**Survey Places Sheinbaum’s Approval Rating at 70%  
** The President attributed the support to honesty and the fulfillment of
commitments in well-being programs, infrastructure projects, and public
security. Sheinbaum recalled Francisco I. Madero and reaffirmed the principles
of the Fourth Transformation: “Don’t lie, don’t steal, and don’t betray the
people.”
